output:
  html_document:
    includes:
      in_header: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kameronyork/kameronyork.github.io/main/projects/movie-draft/headers/hans-haroldsen-family-1.html"
      after_body: "https://kameronyork.com/parables/footer.html"
---
<br>
<br>

<div class="cn-chart-wrap">
  <canvas id="earningsChart" width="400" height="200"></canvas>
</div>

<ul class="cn-tab-nav" id="cnTabNav">
  <li><a href="#" class="cn-tab-link active" data-target="participants-panel" onclick="cnShowTab(event, 'participants-panel')">Participants</a></li>
  <li><a href="#" class="cn-tab-link" data-target="metrics-panel" onclick="cnShowTab(event, 'metrics-panel')">Movie Metrics</a></li>
  <li><a href="#" class="cn-tab-link" data-target="upcoming-panel" onclick="cnShowTab(event, 'upcoming-panel')">Upcoming Movies</a></li>
</ul>

<div id="participants-panel" class="cn-tab-panel">
  <div id="tables-container"></div>
</div>
<div id="metrics-panel" class="cn-tab-panel" style="display:none;">
  <div id="metrics-container"></div>
</div>
<div id="upcoming-panel" class="cn-tab-panel" style="display:none;">
  <div id="upcoming-container"></div>
</div>

<style>
  .expandable-row:hover {
    background-color: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3); /* Transparent gold color */
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .cn-chart-wrap {
    max-width: 800px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  #earningsChart {
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .cn-tab-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 20px 0 0 0;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .cn-tab-nav li {
    margin: 0;
  }
  .cn-tab-link {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #636363;
    font-weight: 500;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-bottom: none;
    border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
  }
  .cn-tab-link:hover {
    background-color: #eef0f5;
    color: var(--primary-color, #02007e);
  }
  .cn-tab-link.active {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    color: var(--primary-color, #02007e);
    border-color: #e0e0e0;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #ffffff;
    margin-bottom: -2px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .cn-tab-panel {
    padding-top: 16px;
  }

  .cn-table-scroll {
    width: 100%;

    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  .cn-movie-old-row td {

  }

    font-size: 0.82em;
    color: #888888;
    border-top: none;
    padding-top: 2px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    background-color: #fafafa;
  }
  .cn-upcoming-table img {
    width: 60px;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: block;
  }
  .cn-upcoming-table td {

  }

  .cn-movie-poster-detail {
    display: flex;

  }
  .cn-movie-poster-detail img {
    width: 50px;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 4px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: block;
  }
  .cn-movie-poster-detail p {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #555555;
  }

  .cn-controls-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: flex-end;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .cn-control {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #555555;
  }
  .cn-control select {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    border: 1px solid #cccccc;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.95em;
    background-color: #ffffff;
  }
  .cn-checkbox-control {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .cn-checkbox-control input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    margin: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
  .cn-checkbox-control span {
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .cn-direction-btn {
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--primary-color, #02007e);
    background-color: #ffffff;
    color: var(--primary-color, #02007e);
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.9em;
  }
  .cn-direction-btn:hover {
    background-color: var(--primary-color, #02007e);
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .cn-tab-link {
      padding: 8px 12px;
      font-size: 0.85em;
    }
    table {
      font-size: 0.82em;
    }
    .cn-controls-row {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .cn-direction-btn {
      align-self: stretch;
    }
    .cn-upcoming-table img,
    .cn-movie-poster-detail img {
      width: 42px;
    }
  }
</style>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
// Function to toggle row visibility
function toggleRow(rowId) {
  const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
  if (row) {
    row.style.display = row.style.display === 'none' ? 'table-row' : 'none';
  }
}

// Function to switch between tabs
function cnShowTab(event, targetId) {
  event.preventDefault();
  document.querySelectorAll('.cn-tab-panel').forEach(panel => {
    panel.style.display = 'none';
  });
  const target = document.getElementById(targetId);
  if (target) {
    target.style.display = '';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.cn-tab-link').forEach(link => {
    link.classList.remove('active');
  });
  event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async function() {
  // Define start date and cutoff date
  const startDate = new Date("2024-11-01"); // Replace with your desired start date
  const cutoffDate = new Date("2025-01-31"); // Replace with your desired cutoff date
  const today = new Date();
  const endDate = today <= cutoffDate ? today : cutoffDate;

  // URLs for data
  const dataUrl = "https://kameronyork.com/datasets/box-office-data.json";
  const peopleUrl = "https://kameronyork.com/datasets/movies.json";
  const detailsUrl = "https://kameronyork.com/datasets/movies-details.json";

  let movieData, peopleData, movieDetailsData;

  try {
    const [movieResponse, peopleResponse, detailsResponse] = await Promise.all([fetch(dataUrl), fetch(peopleUrl), fetch(detailsUrl)]);
    if (!movieResponse.ok || !peopleResponse.ok || !detailsResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to fetch data.');
    }
    movieData = await movieResponse.json();
    peopleData = await peopleResponse.json();
    movieDetailsData = await detailsResponse.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching data:", error);
    return;
  }

  // Filter peopleData for competition "hansFamily1"
  peopleData = peopleData.filter(person => person.competition === "hansFamily1");

  // Lookup of movie poster/description/release date by IMDB id, used by the
  // Participants tab (poster + description on expand) and the Upcoming Movies tab.
  const detailsById = {};
  movieDetailsData.forEach(detail => {
    detailsById[detail.id] = detail;
  });

  const cumulativeData = {};

  // Filter and sort dates based on start date and end date
  const allDates = Array.from(new Set(movieData.map(entry => entry.Date)))
    .filter(date => {
      const currentDate = new Date(date);
      return currentDate >= startDate && currentDate <= endDate;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a) - new Date(b));

  // Initialize cumulativeData with all dates set to 0 for each person
  for (const person of peopleData) {
    cumulativeData[person.name] = {
      earningsByDate: {},
      totalEarnings: 0,
      movies: [],
    };
    allDates.forEach(date => {
      cumulativeData[person.name].earningsByDate[date] = 0;
    });
  }

  // Sum cumulative earnings per person per day
  for (const person of peopleData) {
    for (const movie of person.movies) {
      const movieEntries = movieData.filter(entry => entry.IMDB_ID === movie.imdb_id);

      let cumulativeSum = 0;
      let movieEarningsByDate = [];

      allDates.forEach(date => {
        const entry = movieEntries.find(e => e.Date === date);
        if (entry) {
          cumulativeSum += parseInt(entry.Daily.replace(/[\$,]/g, '')) || 0;
        }
        cumulativeData[person.name].earningsByDate[date] += cumulativeSum;

        // Track individual movie earnings
        if (cumulativeSum > 0) {
          movieEarningsByDate.push({ date, amount: cumulativeSum });
        }
      });

      // Store movie details
      cumulativeData[person.name].movies.push({
        title: movie.title,
        imdb_id: movie.imdb_id,
        points: movie.points,
        periodToDateTotal: cumulativeSum,
        earnings: movieEarningsByDate
      });
    }
  }

  // Prepare data for line chart
  const colors = [
    'rgb(255, 99, 132)',    // Red
    'rgb(54, 162, 235)',    // Blue
    'rgb(255, 206, 86)',    // Yellow
    'rgb(0, 128, 0)',       // Green
    'rgb(153, 102, 255)',   // Purple
    'rgb(255, 159, 64)',    // Orange
    'rgb(128, 0, 0)',       // Maroon
    'rgb(0, 0, 128)',       // Navy
    'rgb(128, 128, 0)',     // Olive
    'rgb(128, 0, 128)',     // Violet
    'rgb(0, 128, 128)',     // Dark Cyan
    'rgb(220, 20, 60)',     // Crimson
    'rgb(255, 69, 0)',      // Red-Orange
    'rgb(50, 205, 50)',     // Lime Green
    'rgb(70, 130, 180)',    // Steel Blue
    'rgb(255, 140, 0)',     // Dark Orange
    'rgb(75, 192, 192)',    // Teal
    'rgb(154, 205, 50)',    // Yellow-Green
    'rgb(139, 0, 139)',     // Dark Magenta
    'rgb(0, 255, 255)'      // Aqua
  ];

  const sortedNames = Object.keys(cumulativeData).sort();

  const datasets = sortedNames.map((name, index) => ({
    label: name,
    data: allDates.map(date => cumulativeData[name].earningsByDate[date]),
    fill: false,
    borderColor: colors[index % colors.length],
    tension: 0.1
  }));

  // Plot the chart
  new Chart(document.getElementById("earningsChart"), {
    type: "line",
    data: { labels: allDates, datasets },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      plugins: { legend: { display: true, position: "top" } },
      scales: {
        x: { title: { display: true, text: "Date" } },
        y: { title: { display: true, text: "Cumulative Earnings" } }
      }
    }
  });

  // Sort people by total earnings for table
  const sortedPeople = Object.entries(cumulativeData)
    .map(([personName, data]) => ({
      name: personName,
      totalEarnings: data.movies.reduce((sum, movie) => sum + movie.periodToDateTotal, 0),
      data
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.totalEarnings - a.totalEarnings);

  // Build a single table for all data below the chart
  let tableHtml = `
    <div class="cn-table-scroll">
    <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Participant</th>
          <th>Total Earnings</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
  `;

  sortedPeople.forEach(({ name, totalEarnings, data }, index) => {
    const personRowId = `person-row-${index}`;
    tableHtml += `
      <tr class="expandable-row" onclick="toggleRow('${personRowId}')">
        <td>${name}</td>
        <td>$${totalEarnings.toLocaleString()}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr id="${personRowId}" style="display: none;">
        <td colspan="2">
          <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Movie</th>
                <th>Period-to-Date Total</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
    `;

    data.movies.forEach((movie, movieIndex) => {
      const movieRowId = `movie-row-${index}-${movieIndex}`;
      const movieDetails = detailsById[movie.imdb_id] || {};

      tableHtml += `
        <tr class="expandable-row" onclick="toggleRow('${movieRowId}')">
          <td>${movie.title}</td>
          <td>$${movie.periodToDateTotal.toLocaleString()}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr id="${movieRowId}" style="display: none;">
          <td colspan="2">
            <div class="cn-movie-poster-detail">
              ${movieDetails.image_url ? `<img src="${movieDetails.image_url}" alt="${movie.title}">` : ''}
              <p>${movieDetails.description || 'No description available.'}</p>
            </div>
            <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Date</th>
                  <th>Cumulative Earnings</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
      `;
      movie.earnings.forEach(entry => {
        tableHtml += `
          <tr>
            <td>${entry.date}</td>
            <td>$${entry.amount.toLocaleString()}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tableHtml += `
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </td>
        </tr>
      `;
    });

    tableHtml += `
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });

  tableHtml += `
      </tbody>
    </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("tables-container").innerHTML = tableHtml;

  // Build a per-movie aggregate used by the Movie Metrics and Upcoming Movies tabs.
  // Each movie in this competition is auctioned to exactly one buyer, so there is
  // one aggregate row per movie. A handful of draft picks have no imdb_id yet
  // (still-untitled/unannounced movies) — fall back to a synthetic per-person key
  // so two such movies never collide and silently overwrite one another.
  const movieAggregate = {};
  Object.entries(cumulativeData).forEach(([personName, data]) => {
    data.movies.forEach(movie => {
      const aggregateKey = movie.imdb_id || `no-id::${personName}::${movie.title}`;
      movieAggregate[aggregateKey] = {
        title: movie.title,
        imdb_id: aggregateKey,
        points: movie.points || 0,
        gross: movie.periodToDateTotal,
        owner: personName
      };
    });
  });

  // Rank every drafted movie by its period-to-date gross (1 = highest grossing) —
  // shared by the Movie Metrics and Upcoming Movies tabs
  const grossRanked = Object.values(movieAggregate).slice().sort((a, b) => b.gross - a.gross);
  const rankById = {};
  grossRanked.forEach((movie, index) => {
    rankById[movie.imdb_id] = index + 1;
  });
  const totalDraftedMovies = grossRanked.length;

  // ---- Movie Metrics tab ----
  // One row per movie (Movie grouping)
  const metricsByMovie = Object.values(movieAggregate).map(movie => ({
    name: movie.title,
    imdb_id: movie.imdb_id,
    owner: movie.owner,
    points: movie.points,
    gross: movie.gross,
    dollarsPerPoint: movie.points > 0 ? movie.gross / movie.points : null,
    rank: rankById[movie.imdb_id]
  }));

  // One row per participant, with totals across all of their movies (Participant grouping)
  const participantTotals = {};
  Object.values(movieAggregate).forEach(movie => {
    if (!participantTotals[movie.owner]) {
      participantTotals[movie.owner] = { name: movie.owner, points: 0, gross: 0 };
    }
    participantTotals[movie.owner].points += movie.points;
    participantTotals[movie.owner].gross += movie.gross;
  });

  // Rank participants by their total gross (1 = highest grossing participant)
  const participantGrossRanked = Object.values(participantTotals).slice().sort((a, b) => b.gross - a.gross);
  const participantRankByName = {};
  participantGrossRanked.forEach((participant, index) => {
    participantRankByName[participant.name] = index + 1;
  });

  const metricsByParticipant = Object.values(participantTotals).map(participant => ({
    name: participant.name,
    points: participant.points,
    gross: participant.gross,
    dollarsPerPoint: participant.points > 0 ? participant.gross / participant.points : null,
    rank: participantRankByName[participant.name]
  }));

  const metricsShell = `
    <div class="cn-controls-row">
      <label class="cn-control">
        Group by
        <select id="metricsGroupBy">
          <option value="movie" selected>Movie</option>
          <option value="participant">Participant</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="cn-control">
        Filter by participant
        <select id="metricsOwnerFilter">
          <option value="all">All Participants</option>
          ${sortedNames.map(name => `<option value="${name}">${name}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="cn-control">
        Sort by
        <select id="metricsSortColumn">
          <option value="gross">Total Domestic Gross</option>
          <option value="dollarsPerPoint" selected>Dollars per Point</option>
          <option value="rank">Rank</option>
          <option value="name" id="metricsSortNameOption">Movie</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <button type="button" id="metricsSortDirection" class="cn-direction-btn" data-direction="desc">Descending &#9660;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="cn-table-scroll">
      <table border="1" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
        <thead id="metricsThead"></thead>
        <tbody id="metricsTbody"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("metrics-container").innerHTML = metricsShell;

  function renderMetricsTable() {
    const groupBy = document.getElementById('metricsGroupBy').value;
    const ownerFilter = document.getElementById('metricsOwnerFilter').value;
    const sortColumn = document.getElementById('metricsSortColumn').value;
    const directionBtn = document.getElementById('metricsSortDirection');
    const direction = directionBtn.getAttribute('data-direction');
    const isMovieMode = groupBy === 'movie';

    let rows = (isMovieMode ? metricsByMovie : metricsByParticipant).slice();
    if (ownerFilter !== 'all') {
      rows = rows.filter(row => (isMovieMode ? row.owner : row.name) === ownerFilter);
    }

    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      const valA = a[sortColumn];
      const valB = b[sortColumn];

      // Rows with no points spent have a null Dollars per Point (N/A) — always
      // sink those to the bottom regardless of sort direction.
      if (sortColumn === 'dollarsPerPoint') {
        if (valA === null && valB === null) return 0;
        if (valA === null) return 1;
        if (valB === null) return -1;
      }

      let cmp;
      if (typeof valA === 'string') {
        cmp = valA.localeCompare(valB);
      } else {
        cmp = valA - valB;
      }
      return direction === 'asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
    });

    const thead = document.getElementById('metricsThead');
    thead.innerHTML = isMovieMode
      ? `<tr><th>Movie</th><th>Bought By</th><th>Points Spent</th><th>Total Domestic Gross</th><th>Rank</th><th>Dollars per Point</th></tr>`
      : `<tr><th>Participant</th><th>Points Spent</th><th>Total Domestic Gross</th><th>Rank</th><th>Dollars per Point</th></tr>`;

    const tbody = document.getElementById('metricsTbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(row => {
      const dollarsPerPointDisplay = row.dollarsPerPoint === null
        ? 'N/A'
        : '$' + Math.round(row.dollarsPerPoint).toLocaleString();

      if (isMovieMode) {
        return `
          <tr>
            <td>${row.name}</td>
            <td>${row.owner}</td>
            <td>${row.points.toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td>$${row.gross.toLocaleString()}</td>
            <td>${row.rank}</td>
            <td>${dollarsPerPointDisplay}</td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }
      return `
        <tr>
          <td>${row.name}</td>
          <td>${row.points.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>$${row.gross.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td>${row.rank}</td>
          <td>${dollarsPerPointDisplay}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  document.getElementById('metricsGroupBy').addEventListener('change', function() {
    document.getElementById('metricsSortNameOption').textContent = this.value === 'movie' ? 'Movie' : 'Participant';
    renderMetricsTable();
  });
  document.getElementById('metricsOwnerFilter').addEventListener('change', renderMetricsTable);
  document.getElementById('metricsSortColumn').addEventListener('change', renderMetricsTable);
  document.getElementById('metricsSortDirection').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const isDesc = this.getAttribute('data-direction') === 'desc';
    const newDirection = isDesc ? 'asc' : 'desc';
    this.setAttribute('data-direction', newDirection);
    this.innerHTML = newDirection === 'asc' ? 'Ascending &#9650;' : 'Descending &#9660;';
    renderMetricsTable();
  });

  renderMetricsTable();

  // ---- Upcoming Movies tab ----
  // Parse a release date value as a local calendar date (no time component), so
  // comparisons against "today" aren't thrown off by UTC-vs-local parsing quirks.
  // Handles a plain "YYYY-MM-DD" prefix (even if trailing time/timezone text is
  // attached to it) and falls back to native Date parsing for any other format
  // (ISO datetime, "Month D, YYYY", timestamps, etc.) so a format we didn't
  // anticipate degrades to "unknown" instead of silently breaking every row.
  function parseReleaseDate(dateValue) {
    if (!dateValue && dateValue !== 0) return null;

    const isoMatch = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(dateValue).trim());
    if (isoMatch) {
      const year = Number(isoMatch[1]);
      const month = Number(isoMatch[2]);
      const day = Number(isoMatch[3]);
      const parsed = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
      if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return parsed;
    }

    const fallback = new Date(dateValue);
    if (!isNaN(fallback.getTime())) {
      return new Date(fallback.getFullYear(), fallback.getMonth(), fallback.getDate());
    }

    return null;
  }

  // Movies release on or before today are considered released: greyed out, and
  // excluded when "Upcoming Only" is checked.
  const todayDateOnly = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate());

  const farFutureDate = new Date(8640000000000000); // used to push unknown release dates to the end when sorting

  const upcomingRows = Object.values(movieAggregate).map(movie => {
    const details = detailsById[movie.imdb_id] || {};
    const releaseDateObj = parseReleaseDate(details.release_date);
    const isReleased = releaseDateObj !== null && releaseDateObj <= todayDateOnly;
    return {
      title: movie.title,
      imdb_id: movie.imdb_id,
      owner: movie.owner,
      image_url: details.image_url || '',
      description: details.description || '',
      release_date: details.release_date || null,
      gross: movie.gross,
      rank: rankById[movie.imdb_id],
      isReleased
    };
  });

  // Sort by release date ASC, then title ASC
  upcomingRows.sort((a, b) => {
    const dateA = parseReleaseDate(a.release_date) || farFutureDate;
    const dateB = parseReleaseDate(b.release_date) || farFutureDate;
    const dateDiff = dateA - dateB;
    if (dateDiff !== 0) return dateDiff;
    return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  });

  const upcomingShell = `
    <div class="cn-controls-row">
      <label class="cn-control cn-checkbox-control">
        <input type="checkbox" id="upcomingOnlyFilter">
        <span>Upcoming Only</span>
      </label>
    </div>
    <div class="cn-table-scroll">
      <table border="1" class="cn-upcoming-table" style="width:100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Poster</th>
            <th>Title &amp; Description</th>
            <th>Release Date</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="upcomingTbody"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("upcoming-container").innerHTML = upcomingShell;

  function renderUpcomingRows() {
    const upcomingOnly = document.getElementById('upcomingOnlyFilter').checked;
    const rows = upcomingOnly ? upcomingRows.filter(row => !row.isReleased) : upcomingRows;

    const tbody = document.getElementById('upcomingTbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(row => {
      const rowClass = row.isReleased ? 'cn-movie-old-row' : '';
      const captionClass = row.isReleased ? 'cn-movie-old-row cn-movie-caption-row' : 'cn-movie-caption-row';

      return `
        <tr class="${rowClass}">
          <td>${row.image_url ? `<img src="${row.image_url}" alt="${row.title}">` : ''}</td>
          <td><strong>${row.title}</strong><br>${row.description || ''}</td>
          <td>${row.release_date || 'Unknown'}</td>
        </tr>
        <tr class="${captionClass}">
          <td colspan="3">Total Domestic Gross: $${row.gross.toLocaleString()} &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; Rank: #${row.rank} of ${totalDraftedMovies} drafted movies &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; Drafted by: ${row.owner}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  document.getElementById('upcomingOnlyFilter').addEventListener('change', renderUpcomingRows);

  renderUpcomingRows();
});
</script>
